description:
All-in-one ebook reader

Koodo Reader is an all-in-one eBook reader for Windows, macOS, Linux, and the web, supporting over 15 formats.
New Features
- The table of content now displays the number of pages by default; there is no need to enable the “Total Pages” feature separately.
- Software security has been optimized to address an arbitrary code execution vulnerability caused by metadata.
- An additional confirmation step has been added when importing books via external links using the URL scheme to enhance security.
- The “Ask AI” feature now supports the Ctrl + Enter shortcut for submitting questions.
- Added an eraser tool to Doodle Mode
- Added support for 7 languages on the official website
- (Mobile) Added a feature to resync all book covers; go to Settings > Sync options
- (Mobile) Optimized the smoothness of page-turning animations
- (Mobile) Optimized the smoothness of certain app animations
- (Mobile) Added an option to download images in CBZ comic mode
Fixes
- Fixed an issue where footnotes in some books did not appear in a pop-up window
- Fixed an issue where reading progress could not be tracked for some books containing special styles
- Fixed an issue where table of contents highlighting did not work after enabling “Total Pages”
- Fixed an issue where page numbers were not displayed in the table of contents for some TXT books
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where authorization via the browser failed on older iOS versions, resulting in a blank page
- (Mobile Version) Fixed abnormal slider behavior on iOS
- (Mobile Version) Fixed an issue where swiping on an image triggered image preview in scroll mode
- (Mobile Version) Fixed an issue where text could not be selected in the Android version after enabling recommended layout under certain conditions
- (Mobile Version) Fixed stuttering issues when enabling TTS for some book
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue on iOS where the horizontal bar in the bottom navigation bar did not automatically hide during reading
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where footnotes for some books did not appear in a pop-up window
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where reading progress could not be tracked for some books containing special styles
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where page numbers were not displayed on the table of contents for some TXT books
Tip
You can also download the installation package for this version from the our self-hosted mirror.
